events.shared: You pressed Share with them under With a meeting's guests in the Share panel, and the page went to a meeting's guests

permissions: reads the events of your own calendars in your Synapse Master, three days back and a week ahead, with their guests
shares the page or task with each guest of the meeting you pressed, and sends each the same letter Send sends, only when you press Share with them
touches.remove: Turn the switch share_meeting off on its row in Evolution, Mutations: the Share panel has no such line and the route refuses. To remove it for good revert night 30's share_meeting commit (rouh/share_meeting.py, the meetings route and its lines in rouh/web/guests.py and rouh/project/urls.py, shareMeetings in rouh/static/app/runs.js, the shareMeetings box in index.html and its rules in app.css, this manifest).
